name: roll-and-drain
description: Serve a ball (bd_trough eject) and autolaunch it at full strength. With Story 2.1c's orbit routing (col_loop_top re-joined, both Loop lanes widened to 66 mm, a return rail and an inlane feed per side) the ball crosses the top of the table, descends the LEFT lane, and rides col_guide_inlane_feed_l onto the left bat, where this golden's recorded press (tick 8500, released 8700) genuinely meets it -- the ball is in the left bat band from tick 8634 onward -- and it then drains at 9281, three ticks sooner than the same run with the press removed (9284). [Retimed 2026-09-03, code review pass 2 rework: durationTicks 9289 -> 9282, expectedHash/expectedGameStateHash refreshed -- see notes.] Real gameplay input only (no manual ball placement); traced and verified deterministic this pass.
